How I work

I believe good design is facilitated, not produced by one person in isolation.

01

Make the system visible.

Before screens, I map what the product is, with the people who have to build it. The product can be theirs. The model still comes first.

02

Decide what matters first.

Research picks what is worth building first. The interface then makes that choice, instead of handing someone a pile of filters and wishing them luck.

03

Bring the team along.

I stay in the room with product, research, and engineering until the decision is something they can build. The handoff is a shared model, not a file drop.

If there’s a question your product should answer and can’t yet, send it my way.
